purpose: Summarise valid uploaded observations inside one user-confirmed geographic area and historical time.

execution_tiers.name: Mapped observation summary
execution_tiers.claim: Counts, condition shares and the mean uploaded value inside the confirmed area

execution_tiers.name: Metric-weighted area summary
execution_tiers.claim: The same descriptive summary with an explicitly named uploaded measure

mathematical_formulation.membership: Observation i is included exactly when west <= longitude_i <= east and south <= latitude_i <= north
mathematical_formulation.mean: arithmetic mean over finite valid observations inside the confirmed rectangle
mathematical_formulation.condition_share: count in each disclosed condition class divided by the valid in-area count

primary_sources.citation: Jenelius, E. and Mattsson, L.-G. (2012). Road network vulnerability analysis of area-covering disruptions: A grid-based approach with case study. Transportation Research Part A, 46(5), 746-760.
primary_sources.relationship: Supports explicit spatial aggregation and the distinction between a mapped area unit and an individual link. The platform summary itself remains descriptive.

verification_contract: The rectangle uses valid west, south, east and north coordinates
Every counted observation belongs to the uploaded project and selected historical time
Only finite valid metric values enter the mean
Condition shares sum to one within floating-point tolerance when valid observations exist
known_limitations: No network propagation, demand response or causal disaster consequence is inferred
The rectangle is a user-defined analysis area, not a hazard footprint or administrative boundary
Unknown local-coordinate or topology-only layouts cannot run this geographic-area method
